title: ALU (Arithmetic Logic Unit)
summary: The ALU performs arithmetic and logical operations on integer operands. Typical operations: ADD, SUB, AND, OR, XOR, NOT, SHL (shift left), SHR (shift right), SAR (arithmetic shift right), ROL (rotate left), ROR (rotate right), CMP (compare, sets flags), TEST (AND without storing result). Flags: ZF (zero), SF (sign), CF (carry), OF (overflow), PF (parity).

notes: The ALU is the computational core of the CPU.
Modern ALUs are pipelined and can execute multiple operations per cycle.
SIMD ALUs operate on multiple data elements in parallel (SSE, AVX, NEON).
The ALU result feeds the flags register, which controls conditional branches.
ALU operations are typically combinational (no clock needed, just propagation delay).
